query: SELECT inference.id, inference.error, (inference.output IS NULL AND inference.error IS NULL AND inference.finished_at IS NULL) AS "running!: bool", CASE WHEN inference.output IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message WHERE message.source_inference_id = inference.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM summary WHERE summary.inference_id = inference.id) THEN inference.output END AS "aside_content?: i64" FROM inference WHERE inference.history_entry_id = ?
